recommended_next_phase: Phase 149O.20L.7D -- Dell Class-B Real Host Provisioning Execution. Must independently recheck at entry: CHGR currentness, revocation/supersession state, machine identity, source binding, contract versions, principal collisions, filesystem-path collisions, command-plan identity, wrapper digest, and privilege posture -- then execute only the exact nine-action plan already frozen in the pinned 149O.20L.7B.1 commit, with no broadening of scope. summary: Phase 149O.20L.7C -- Dell Class-B Boundary-P Authorization Independent Verification. VERIFICATION-ONLY. Independently reconstructed and adversarially attacked the Dell-specific CHGR (chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832) published by Phase 149O.20L.7B.2, re-deriving every claim from primary sources (.pcae/ on-disk artifacts, live git object history, live pcae CLI, and a fresh read-only SSH session to hac-dell) rather than trusting 7B.2's report. Independently reconstructed CHGR-001 semantics from the frozen contract text and cross-checked against live CLI behavior. Independently reconstructed the exact Dell CHGR (record_id, lifecycle_state published, selected_option_id approve, decision_subject, rationale, conditions, digests, timestamps). Verified APPROVE election authenticity (explicit first-person selection among a real three-option set, no default/inferred/carried-forward value). Confirmed the successful session CDS-adb67041-3a30-4b4e-a188-e6284e7743be is distinct from the historical AMEND session CDS-cf123bbf-... and from both cancelled sessions, with no identity collision or stale-state inheritance. Traced the complete create->evidence->select->preview->confirm->readiness->publish chain via the orchestration record's completed_stages, confirming a single coherent chain with no cross-session assembly. Independently reconstructed and confirmed the preview digest (e49caf228bdbddda27277f1b37ad06cd71bd68a60bd5aa6a8faacd50d899033d) binds the Dell decision subject, selected option, evidence references, rationale, and conditions. Located and inventoried both disclosed cancelled sessions (CDS-506d69fd-... wrong-commit citation of a real but incorrect commit; CDS-e020f5a5-... a fabricated/hand-padded 40-hex-char string sharing only an 8-char prefix with the real commit and not resolving to any git object) and independently proved, by full-file search across the successful session/preview/readiness-package/CHGR, that neither bad evidence identifier appears anywhere in the successful chain -- zero contamination. Verified all three evidence references in the successful chain resolve to real, existing, provenance-verifiable objects (no fabricated identifier). Independently re-verified the pinned source SHA 7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a is a real 40-hex-char commit, an ancestor of origin/main, and contains HBDC-001 v1.0, HMIC-001 v1.3, HMRC-001 v1.1, and the Class-B verifier source with HBDC-REQ-042 present. Independently re-ran the source-drift diff since the pin: 33 changed paths, all under .pcae/**, docs/tasks metadata, and phase-specific docs/tests -- zero src/pcae/**, scripts/**, or docs/contracts/** changes. Confirmed target binding is by stable machine-id (54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334), not mutable alias/hostname/IP. Performed a fresh, strictly read-only SSH session to hac-dell this phase, confirming matching machine-id/hostname/architecture, absence of a pcae user, and absence of /opt/pcae* paths -- no material target drift, no mutation. Reconstructed the immutable 149O.20L.7B.1 proposition directly from its pinned historical commit object (not current working-tree text), proving the CHGR binds fixed historical bytes. Independently recovered and spot-verified all nine authorized actions, the package-management boundary (python3-venv/python3-pip only, explicit rollback caveat, no general apt authority), principal binding (pcae/pcae, nologin, no sudo, no unrelated group membership, CONFLICTING->STOP on any pre-existing account), and filesystem binding (only the shared /opt/pcae/projects container is initial-provisioning authority; the per-repository path template is explicitly not). Independently reconstructed the exact 188-byte launch-wrapper bytes from the pinned document and recomputed its SHA-256 from scratch, obtaining an exact match to the previously reported digest b3e969128ff48ecfae874a9348d889b43f7fc336bf170387b912b1cfc3753c32; independently verified the wrapper's disclosed semantics (set -eu, PYTHONPATH removal, PYTHONNOUSERSITE, fixed PATH, expected CWD, pinned venv executable, argument forwarding, no shell-profile sourcing) match the actual bytes exactly. Independently re-derived from source (not from any phase report) that the expected Action-9 residual {HBDC-REQ-042} is architecturally correct given the frozen plan never creates a DeploymentBinding, while explicitly distinguishing this as a well-founded prediction about an unmeasured future postcondition, not a measured result. Independently confirmed the CHGR's own conditions text expressly excludes DeploymentBinding creation, Boundary C certification, Boundary A activation, Permission Broker changes, arbitrary repository onboarding, and centralized multi-repository governance -- no implicit authorization found anywhere. Independently re-confirmed human authority identity via the canonical decision_maker_identity_evidence mechanism (typed_confirmation_only, identifier Atila Madai), not derived merely from free-text rationale. Independently re-ran pcae governance-record inspect and verify against the live Dell CHGR, reproducing the prior 7-of-7-substantive-checks-passed / template_resolution-skipped result directly (not cited from 7B.2), and independently re-ran the identical verify command against the historical Mac CHGR to confirm the same skip is pre-existing, uniform CLI behavior across both records -- classified as a legitimate optional skip. Confirmed no revocation or supersession mechanism/marker exists anywhere in .pcae/ for the Dell CHGR. Confirmed the historical Mac CHGR and AMEND session remain unmodified, unreused, and structurally separate from the Dell authority chain. Documented a non-blocking tooling-hardening observation: evidence citations are not existence-validated by the CLI at declaration time (both cancelled sessions in this chain were caught only by operator discipline, not tooling) -- classified as a future hardening candidate, not a defect compromising the published Dell CHGR. Documented, without silently correcting, two prose/value-length mismatches discovered in the orchestrating task's own narration (the 7B.1 evidence commit described as 41 chars when it is actually 40; the wrapper digest described as 71 hex chars when it is actually 64) -- both independently investigated and resolved as narration mismatches in the task description, not defects in any governance artifact. Documented, without repairing, a pre-existing and unrelated 2-test failure in the older tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7b_dell_class_b_boundary_p_authorization_record_capture.py module, caused by that module's own temporal assertions having legitimately become false as later phases progressed the Dell chain forward -- out of scope for a verification-only phase. Final Boundary-P verdict: VERIFIED AUTHORIZED. No Blocking defect found. New, independently authored companion test module -- 82 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 82 passed each run, no flake -- encoding every assertion above in machine-checked form, independent of the 7B.2 test module. No Dell mutation occurred at any point this phase -- every command against hac-dell was strictly read-only. No new decision session, readiness package, or CHGR was created by this phase. Boundary P is now INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AUTHORIZED BY CHGR chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832; Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED; DeploymentBinding, Boundary C, and Boundary A remain NOT AUTHORIZED; HATP remains NOT READY; runtime unchanged. Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7D -- Dell Class-B Real Host Provisioning Execution, which must independently recheck the full freshness/invalidation checklist at its own entry before executing only the exact frozen nine-action plan, and must itself be followed by a further, separately governed independent-verification phase before the provisioning result is treated as independently established. Not begun by this phase.
